item.text: {"text":"The traceback only reports that `train.py` exited unsuccessfully; it does not include the underlying exception. The supplied code already prints that exception and saves it to `working/training_error.txt` beneath the trial directory.\n\nProvide that file’s contents or the child process’s traceback. Without it, a SEARCH/REPLACE fix would be speculative and could break the required lexical HSTU experiment."}
